placements.frozen: Exact C7a seeded executable and 64+32 configuration.
placements.ordinary: New executable with the general witness interpreter on the frontend and FFT on main.
placements.front-fft: Keep the existing 32-core solver. Run FFT on the 32-core frontend.
placements.solver8: Run only the witness interpreter on one 8-core L3 group. FFT stays on main.
placements.solver16: Run only the witness interpreter on two 8-core L3 groups. FFT stays on main.
placements.solver8-front: Use the 8-core solver and move FFT to the original 32-core frontend.
placements.solver16-front: Use the 16-core solver and move FFT to the original 32-core frontend.

curves: All placements keep the previously selected 64+32 curve and G1 K placement.
calibration: Absolute paired median <=2% for same-build ordinary vs frozen on each input.
qualification: Faster paired median and at least 9/12 repeats vs both controls on each fixture.
diagnostics: Clocked process means checked separately within 3% of their paired unclocked arm. Verify each actual prep and FFT worker width through the trace.
correctness: Fixed wires and matching public inputs, fresh external Gnark verification for each exported proof.
